security_advisory.summary: Unintended leak of Proxy-Authorization header in requests
security_advisory.description: Since requests 2.3.0, the library has been leaking Proxy-Authorization headers to destination servers during redirects to an HTTPS endpoint. Affects requests.Session and the top-level helpers requests.get, requests.post, requests.put, requests.delete when proxies are configured via the proxies argument or the HTTPS_PROXY environment variable.

_meta.expected_reason: package directly used (requests.Session, requests.get); repo active and tier 2 — reaches the Final Judge
